name: choomfie
shortDescription: Personal Discord agent that runs on the Claude Code CLI: persistent memory, personas, reminders, and voice/browser/tutor plugins.
description:
Choomfie is a personal Discord agent that runs through a Claude Code CLI plan. It's a multi-surface assistant rather than a one-off chatbot: talk to it in Discord DMs or servers, or drive it from the terminal.

Highlights:
- Persistent memory, switchable personas, reminders, GitHub checks, and Discord interactions (slash commands, buttons, modals).
- An immortal supervisor over a disposable worker, connected to Claude Code over MCP stdio, so the worker can crash or reload without killing the session.
- Daemon mode built on the Agent SDK for autonomous Discord-only operation; it cycles Claude sessions when context gets heavy and writes a handoff summary first.
- Plugins: full-duplex voice chat (local STT/TTS, VAD, interruption handling), Playwright browsing, a language tutor with spaced repetition, and social-media workflows.
- Access control by pairing codes and an allowlist.
